title: Pi Model Alias settings
description: Settings for model and provider display aliases.

$schema.description: JSON Schema used by editors for this settings file.

provider.description: Provider ID that owns the model.

model.description: Original model ID sent to the provider.

alias.description: Short local model ID accepted by Pi.

name.description: Optional displayed model name; omit it to keep Pi's native label.

aliases.description: Short model IDs with optional display-name overrides.

provider.description: Provider ID whose displayed name should change.

providerAliases.description: Provider display-name overrides; provider IDs remain unchanged.

stableProviderColumn.description: Keep the provider column stable when aliases are displayed.
